name: Business proposal
description: A clear proposal opening, readable sections, and space for scope, delivery, and optional calculated pricing. A separate cover and acceptance area are available for documents that need them.
structure: A substantial title, optional subtitle, and prepared-for/by details introduce the proposal. Short proposals begin on the body page; a cover is optional. An optional logo slot sits at the upper right.
A broad reading column supports prose, deliverables, schedules, and exhibits in the author's chosen order.
Optional pricing uses validated data and calculated totals. It can sit wherever it helps the proposal, or be omitted entirely.
References and an optional acceptance area follow the body. Long material flows naturally, with quiet page numbers and an optional running title.
